MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Paul Yee, Esq. for Plaintiff: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company.
Plaintiff's Witness: David Washburn, was sworn and direct examined.

Damages $1,008,889.50
Costs $455.00, for a total of $1,009,344.50
Judgment signed in open court.
